tools.name: getTokenPrice
tools.description: Look up the current USD market price and 24-hour percentage change for a cryptocurrency or stablecoin. Use this whenever the user asks about a token's price, wants to compare token values, or needs pricing context before a swap, transfer, or yield decision.

tools.name: getMyInfo
tools.description: Get information about the authenticated user and their wallet

tools.name: depositForYield
tools.description: Deposit tokens into a DeFi yield strategy to earn passive income. Requires a strategy ID from discoverYieldStrategies. Creates a tracked position that accrues yield over time.

chainKey.description: Blockchain identifier. Accepts: chain ID (8453), chain name ("base"), or CAIP-2 ("eip155:8453")

fromAccountAddress.description: Account address to deposit from (EOA or Smart Account 0x...)

tools.name: onboardingAssistant
tools.description: Interactive guide that walks you through setting up your Finance District wallet for the first time. Provides a clear checklist with step-by-step instructions to configure your wallet, provision signing keys, and get started with available features. Use this tool when you're new to the wallet or need guidance on initial setup.

tone.description: Desired response style: friendly, concise, formal, developer

locale.description: Locale for localized responses (e.g., en-US, en-GB)

context.description: Optional contextual information from prior interactions (JSON object as string)

question.description: Your current question or where you are in the setup process (e.g., 'I want to get started', 'how do I configure my wallet?', 'what do I do next?')

tools.name: discoverYieldStrategies
tools.description: Discover available DeFi yield strategies across multiple protocols (Aave, Compound, Yearn, etc.). Returns strategies with APY, risk scores, and minimum deposit requirements.

limit.description: Optional: Maximum number of strategies to return (1-100). Default: 30.

token.description: Optional: Token to filter by (e.g. "USDC", "WETH", or 0x...). If omitted, returns strategies for all supported tokens.

sortBy.description: Optional: Sort field for results. 'apy' sorts by annual percentage yield, 'risk' sorts by risk score. Default: 'apy'.

chainKey.description: Optional: Blockchain identifier to filter results. Accepts: chain ID (8453), chain name ("base"), or CAIP-2 ("eip155:8453"). If omitted, returns strategies across all supported chains.

protocolSlug.description: Optional: Filter by protocol slug (e.g., 'aave-v3', 'venus', 'compound-v3'). If omitted, returns strategies from all protocols. Takes precedence over type=defi filter.

sortDirection.description: Optional: Sort direction. 'desc' for descending (highest first), 'asc' for ascending (lowest first). Default: 'desc'.

tools.name: transferTokens
tools.description: Transfer tokens from your wallet (Agent Wallet or Smart Account) to any address. Supports EVM chains (native ETH/MATIC and ERC-20 tokens like USDC, USDT), Solana (native SOL and SPL tokens), and Bitcoin (native BTC). Agent Wallet transfers use standard transactions. Smart Account transfers use ERC-4337 with gas sponsorship where available. Returns transaction hash immediately for Agent Wallet, or user operation hash for Smart Account.

asset.description: Asset symbol (e.g., "ETH", "USDC", "SOL", "BTC") or token contract address (0x... for EVM, Base58 for Solana SPL tokens)

chainKey.description: Blockchain identifier. Accepts: chain ID (EVM), chain name i.e., ("ethereum", "base", "solana", "bitcoin", "bitcoin-testnet4"), or CAIP-2 ("bip122:000000000933ea013658bf6367f5601c" for Bitcoin, "eip155:1" for Ethereum, "solana:5eykt4..." for Solana)

toAddress.description: Recipient address or name. Accepts raw addresses (0x-prefixed for EVM, Base58 for Solana, Bech32/Base58 for Bitcoin) or ENS/SNS names (e.g. 'vitalik.eth', 'bonfida.sol').

autoApprove.description: Auto-approve transfer up to configured limit (default: false)

fromAccountAddress.description: Optional: Specify which wallet to transfer from (Agent Wallet address or Smart Account address). If not provided, system will auto-select or prompt.

tools.name: swapTokens
tools.description: Quote or execute a token swap using a provider-agnostic, policy-driven router. Parameters are provided individually (MCP-friendly) and the server constructs a SwapTokensRequest with sane defaults.

amount.description: Amount of TokenIn to swap in decimal. The server converts to atomic units automatically.

chainKey.description: Blockchain identifier. Accepts: chain ID (8453), chain name ("base"), or CAIP-2 ("eip155:8453", "solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp")

maxSlippageBps.description: Optional: max slippage in basis points (0-10000). Default: 50 (0.5%)

deadlineSeconds.description: Optional: swap deadline in seconds from now (default: 120)

tools.name: getWalletOverview
tools.description: Get comprehensive wallet overview including Agent Wallet (EOA) and Smart Accounts with token balances and session state. Shows balances across all 'popular networks' by default, or filters to specific account/chain when provided.

chainKey.description: Filter by blockchain chain identifier. Accepts CAIP-2 (e.g., 'eip155:8453'), chain ID (8453), or network name ('bsc'). If omitted, queries all popular networks for Agent Wallet and all registered chains for Smart Accounts.

accountAddress.description: Optional: Filter by account address. EVM: 0x + 40 hex chars. Solana: Base58-encoded, 32-44 chars. Can be Agent Wallet or Smart Account. If omitted, returns both.

tools.name: withdrawFromYield
tools.description: Withdraw tokens from a DeFi yield position. Works with any yield position, even those not deposited through this wallet. No position tracking required.

chainKey.description: Blockchain identifier. Accepts: chain ID (8453), chain name ("base"), or CAIP-2 ("eip155:8453")

withdrawAmount.description: Amount of vault tokens to withdraw in decimal

vaultTokenAddress.description: Vault token address (0x...) to withdraw from. Use discoverYieldStrategies to find vault token addresses.

fromAccountAddress.description: Account address holding the vault tokens (EOA or Smart Account)

tools.name: reportIssue
tools.description: Report an issue or bug discovered during MCP server testing. Creates a GitHub issue in the repository with the provided details.

labels.description: Optional comma-separated list of labels to apply (e.g., 'bug', 'mcp-tool', 'testing')

description.description: Detailed description of the issue including steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior

tools.name: getX402Content
tools.description: Retrieves structured content from HTTP APIs that implement the X-402 protocol standard for controlled access. Intended for premium data and documentation APIs that are pre-configured by the operator of this server. When an API responds with HTTP 402, the tool follows the configured X-402 flow to obtain the corresponding response body in a safe, read-only format. It does not access arbitrary websites, execute code, or expose any underlying credential or key material.

url.description: API endpoint URL supporting X-402 protocol

maxPaymentAmount.description: Maximum amount willing to pay (decimal string). If exceeded, prompt user.

preferredNetwork.description: Preferred payment network identifier. Accepts: 'base-sepolia', 'eip155:84532', or chain ID '84532'.

preferredNetworkName.description: Human-readable network name for display (e.g., 'Base Sepolia', 'BSC Testnet', 'Ethereum'). ALWAYS provide this alongside preferredNetwork.

tools.name: resolveNameService
tools.description: Resolve ENS names (.eth) or Unstoppable Domains (.crypto, .nft, .wallet etc.) to Ethereum addresses, or Solana Name Service domains (.sol) to Solana pubkeys. Also reverse-resolves EVM addresses (0x...) or Solana pubkeys to their registered names.

nameOrAddress.description: ENS name (e.g. 'vitalik.eth'), SNS domain (e.g. 'bonfida.sol'), Unstoppable Domain for forward resolution, or an EVM address (0x... 42 chars) or Solana pubkey for reverse resolution.

tools.name: getAccountActivity
tools.description: Get transaction history (native transfers, ERC-20 transfers, NFT activity) for a specific account on a specific blockchain. Supports both Agent Wallet (EOA) and Smart Accounts on EVM and Solana chains. Both account address and chain must be specified - activity cannot be mixed across different chains or accounts.

chainKey.description: Blockchain chain identifier (required). Accepts: CAIP-2 (eip155:8453), short names (base, ethereum, polygon, solana), full names (Base Mainnet), or numeric chain IDs (8453, 1, 137). The service intelligently resolves all formats.

accountAddress.description: Account address to query - either Agent Wallet (EOA) or Smart Account address (required). EVM: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Solana: Base58-encoded, 32-44 characters.

maxTransactions.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: helpNarrative
tools.description: Use this when the user asks conceptual or 'why/how' questions about wallet safety, delegation sessions, key management, fees, audit trails, or threat models that need narrative explanations rather than action steps.

tone.description: Desired response style: friendly, concise, formal, developer

locale.description: Locale for localized responses (e.g., en-US, en-GB)

question.description: Conceptual question about wallet safety, delegation, keys, fees, audits, or threats

tools.name: authorizePayment
tools.description: Authorize X-402 payment by selecting best requirement from resource server's 402 response and constructing payment authorization.

autoApprove.description: Auto-approve: if true, automatically selects best option and authorizes; if false, returns selection for user confirmation

paymentRequirementsResponseJson.description: JSON-serialized PaymentRequirementsResponse from resource server (contains x402Version, error, and accepts array)
